eyescan1.explanation: No signs of diabetic retinopathy detected. Routine annual screening is recommended.

eyescan2.explanation: Microaneurysms and scattered hemorrhages consistent with moderate non-proliferative diabetic retinopathy. Referral to an ophthalmologist is recommended within 3 months.

eyescan3.explanation: Extensive hemorrhages and signs of neovascularization consistent with proliferative diabetic retinopathy. Urgent ophthalmology referral recommended.
